item.title: UAC Nigeria Posts Record Revenue Growth In 2025 Amid Profit Decline
item.description: UAC Nigeria PLC ended the 2025 financial year with remarkable revenue gains but a sharp decline in profitability, highlighting the financial trade-offs of the company’s aggressive expansion strategy.
